name: vector
description: Red-team scanning for LLM agents — integrate Vector in your repo, harden against findings, generate agent profiles

interface.longDescription: Vector is a red-team control plane for LLM agents. This plugin connects Codex to the Vector MCP server and ships four skills that wire red-team scans into your codebase: build an adapter and CI step end-to-end, harden against single or batched FAIL verdicts, and generate AgentContext profiles for saved agents.
defaultPrompt: Integrate Vector red-team scanning into this repo
Help me fix these failing red-team findings
Generate an AgentContext JSON for my LLM agent
